blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Rain or Shine coach Yeng Guiao expects a different Converge team that will come out this time when the two independent squads face off in the quarterfinals of the PBA Governors’ Cup. Their best-of-five series will start on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum as the Elasto Painters and the FiberXers meet in the playoffs for just the second time ever, and the first time since the 2024-25 Commissioner’s Cup quarterfinals.
